name: verifiers
description_en: Our library for RL environments + evals
readme_excerpt: Overview verifiers is our library for creating environments to train and evaluate LLMs. verifiers is tightly integrated with the Environments Hub, as well as our training framework prime-rl and our Hosted Training platform. Installation We recommend installing the Prime CLI to interact with the environments.
